picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.2% in November?
picks.why: A rising U.S. jobless rate would signal a cooling labor market and shape how aggressively the Fed sets policy into 2027.

picks.question: Will real GDP increase by more than 1.5% in Q4 2026?
picks.why: Markets see solid late-2026 growth as likely, and a miss would challenge soft-landing assumptions and corporate earnings expectations.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An OpenAI IPO valuation above $1.5 trillion would test how much public investors will pay today for future AI profits.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership at the AI frontier shapes where capital, talent, and cloud revenue concentrate among a handful of tech giants.

picks.question: Will AI solve the Riemann Hypothesis in 2026?
picks.why: An AI proof of a famous open problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning with broad research implications.

picks.question: Will AI solve P versus NP in 2026?
picks.why: Settling P versus NP could upend the assumptions underpinning encryption, online commerce, and optimization across the economy.
